system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. During this Main Process, you gain a +[SRx7] bonus to [Magic Attack] damage rolls.

(CR21): Increase the bonus to [SRx9].

A special skill that stops and concentrates to accumulate magical power. The magic that is unleashed by kneading the magical power in the body and the spiritual power that is sucked up from the earth and the atmosphere is no longer an exceptional power.
